summary: Backend-only testing for Merchandising Shelf Photo Control API. Created /app/backend/tests/test_merch_api.py covering auth, customer access control, location lock, photo upload (in-range/out-of-range/mocked/null-location), admin role gating, admin reset flow, ERP lookup, and customer status logic. 25/25 pytest tests passed (100%) against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.

minor.issue: Endpoint accepts photo_base64 with no size validation; large payloads could bloat MongoDB. Consider a max length check or GridFS for production.
Hard-coded limit(500) with no pagination parameters. Acceptable for MVP but will not scale.
Does not validate that the rep's submitted lat/lon is within any sensible bound (e.g., -90..90). Pydantic Field constraints would help.
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); should migrate to FastAPI lifespan context manager (warning only, not failing).

action_items: Optional: add Pydantic Field constraints (latitude: ge=-90 le=90, longitude: ge=-180 le=180) on ConfirmLocationRequest and PhotoUploadRequest.
Optional: validate photo_base64 length / decodability on upload to avoid DB bloat.
Optional: migrate startup/shutdown handlers to FastAPI lifespan API.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 672 lines; still readable but approaching the 700 line guideline — consider splitting into routers (auth/customers/photos/admin).
MongoDB _id is properly excluded everywhere via projection {"_id": 0}.
JWT secret, Mongo URL, admin/rep credentials all read from env — no hardcoded secrets.
verify_password swallows all exceptions; acceptable for bcrypt format errors but could mask logic bugs — log a warning at minimum.
Username is lowercased on login but seed inserts already lower-case usernames — consistent.
Fake-GPS logging fires both for out-of-range and is_mocked=true and persists user/customer/reason as required.
seed_data_creation: No new seed; relied on backend's own seed (admin, rep01, rep02, C001-C005). Tests reset C003/C004/C005 via admin endpoint to make assertions deterministic and re-confirm where needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_merch_api.py and are idempotent (use admin reset between runs). BASE_URL is hardcoded to the public preview URL; update if EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL changes. C001 stays locked at (40.37650, 49.83260); C002/C004 also locked. C003 and C005 are reset to unlocked/null during test run. Photo uploads accumulate on C001 each run (consider cleanup if growth becomes an issue).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failures. All 17 listed acceptance criteria from the review_request mapped to passing tests: login admin/rep, wrong password 401, /auth/me, by-user list (4 customers w/ status), 403 cross-rep, single customer fetch, confirm-location 200 + 409, photo upload within 30m, out-of-range 400 with fake_gps_logs entry, is_mocked 400 with fake_gps_logs entry, null-location 400, photo by-customer GET, admin endpoints 200/403 matrix, admin reset + re-confirm, ERP shaped JSON, status logic uploaded/not_visited.
